clue.text: Note deficiency, get governors to provide school equipment

parts.note: B is a note of the musical scale
a deficiency is a lack of something
a school's governors form its board

explanation.surface: A memo about shortages urges the school governors to pay for classroom kit.
explanation.definitionFit: A dark board written on with chalk is classic classroom equipment in schools.

clue.text: Grounds or pastures, say

indicators.note: say signals a word that is heard rather than seen

parts.note: leas are meadows or pastures

explanation.surface: Coffee grounds or grazing fields, for instance.
explanation.definitionFit: The sediment of wine is its dregs, like coffee grounds.

clue.text: Bill comes up with new coil of fabric

parts.note: AC is short for account, a bill

indicators.note: the letters are put in a new order

explanation.surface: An invoice arrives with a fresh roll of cloth.
explanation.definitionFit: A plain-woven cotton cloth is a kind of fabric.

clue.text: Key groups?

parts.note: keys on a ring hang together in clusters

explanation.definitionFit: Keys on a ring hang together in clusters, the usual collective word for them.

clue.text: A second son for the prophet

parts.note: a mo is a moment, a second

explanation.surface: A second boy is named after the Old Testament seer.
explanation.definitionFit: An Old Testament book is named after this Hebrew prophet.

clue.text: Faults or defaults

definitions.meaning: to default on a side is to desert it, as a soldier switching sides does

explanation.definitionFit: Flaws in something, and deserts to the other side.

clue.text: Crack ace orbits after a display of stunt flying

indicators.note: the rearranged letters come after the single letter
to crack something is to break it apart and reassemble its letters

explanation.surface: A top pilot circles after a flying stunt show.
explanation.definitionFit: Loops and rolls performed by aircraft are stunt flying.

clue.text: They accommodate those who don't wish to move far when they retire

definitions.text: They accommodate those who don't wish to move far when they retire

parts.words: They accommodate those who don't wish to move far when they retire
parts.note: retire means go to bed: in a one-room flat the bed is steps from the chair

explanation.definitionFit: One-room flats where bed and sitting room are the same space, so going to bed takes no walking.

clue.text: Present her with key

parts.note: E is a musical key

explanation.surface: Someone hands a woman a gift along with a key.
explanation.definitionFit: Present in the sense of being in attendance, at this place, is a synonym.

clue.text: Cancellation of count leads to rebuke

parts.note: to tell is an old word for to count, as a bank teller or vote tellers do
an event called off is cancelled, so off stands for cancellation

explanation.surface: Calling off a vote count prompts a reprimand.
explanation.walkthrough: The pieces appear in reverse clue order: the 'of count' part comes first in the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A scolding is an informal phrase for a rebuke or reprimand.

clue.text: The Spanish weapons that make army manoeuvres possible

parts.note: el is the Spanish word for the
bows are weapons used by archers

explanation.surface: Spanish arms that allow troops to carry out manoeuvres.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Army' is read as arm-y: the joints are what let your arms move about, not soldiers.
explanation.definitionFit: Joints in the middle of the arm let it bend, so they make arm movements possible.

clue.text: Proposition from me to her

indicators.note: the letters are made from the clue words, so they are rearranged here

explanation.surface: A suggestion passed from one person to another.
explanation.definitionFit: In mathematics a statement to be proved is called a proposition.

clue.text: He performs extensively on a sliding scale

definitions.text: He performs extensively on a sliding scale

parts.words: He performs extensively on a sliding scale
parts.note: the player extends a slide to reach notes, so plays a scale by sliding

explanation.definitionFit: A brass player whose instrument changes pitch by extending a slide.

clue.text: Fight before wedding

definitions.meaning: a battle or clash between forces
the period of betrothal before a marriage

explanation.definitionFit: A military clash, and the betrothal period before marriage.

clue.text: Officer in difficult situation turned to other ranks

indicators.note: turned means the word is turned round, read backwards

parts.note: a jam is a tight spot
OR is the military abbreviation for other ranks

explanation.surface: An officer in a fix turns to the enlisted men for help.
explanation.definitionFit: An army officer ranking above captain.

clue.text: Tact as well as art may be needed to draw

indicators.note: the letters of both words are needed in a new arrangement to form the answer

explanation.surface: A portrait artist needs diplomacy as well as skill to sketch a subject.
explanation.walkthrough: 'draw' looks like sketching, which fits the art, but it means to pull in.
explanation.definitionFit: To draw a crowd is to pull people in, a synonym of luring them.

clue.text: Maxim for our time

parts.note: AD, anno domini, marks the years of our era
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: A saying suited to the present day.
explanation.walkthrough: 'our time' gives both pieces: the AD era and the AGE we live in.
explanation.definitionFit: A proverb or saying is a maxim.

clue.text: You may see them by sea and in ship

definitions.text: You may see them by sea

indicators.note: the word and sits inside the ship abbreviation

parts.note: SS stands for steamship

explanation.surface: Things you spot at the seaside and aboard a vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: Beaches are made of grains of sand, seen beside the sea.

clue.text: Musical companion of Bess heading off for a wild party

parts.note: Porgy and Bess is the Gershwin opera; Porgy is Bess's partner

clue.text: Queue for classified information

definitions.meaning: single ... is a line of people waiting
a dossier of sorted records is held in a folder

explanation.definitionFit: A line of people one behind another, and a set of records kept in order.

clue.text: Avoid Kansas city

definitions.meaning: ... City is a town in Kansas famous from Wild West history

clue.text: Ready as can be, I suppose

indicators.note: the letters can be arranged into something else

explanation.surface: Someone shrugs that they are as prepared as possible, presumably.
explanation.definitionFit: An old-fashioned phrase meaning probably or I suppose so.

clue.text: In French clubs, miss will get embrace

parts.note: en is French for in
C is short for clubs in card games
to miss out on something is to lose it

explanation.surface: A girl at French nightclubs will be hugged.
explanation.definitionFit: To embrace is to surround or encompass, as walls do.

clue.text: Insect on head of animal is an annoyance

parts.note: a bug is an insect
a bear is an animal

explanation.definitionFit: A persistent source of irritation or dread is called a pet hate.

clue.text: Comes into force?

parts.note: the force is the armed forces, so one joining up comes into them

explanation.definitionFit: Someone who signs up for military service joins the armed forces.

clue.text: Popular act, certainly

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular
a deed is an act

explanation.surface: A crowd-pleasing performance, without doubt.

clue.text: Quick moving river traps doctor

parts.note: the Nile is the great African river
MB is Bachelor of Medicine, a doctor's degree

clue.text: A girl comes up with a woebegone expression

clue.text: Remain a supporter

clue.text: Outline new house title

clue.text: Yeasty reds drunk in recent times
